## About Data Intelligence AI by BCG X

Successful companies don’t use data, they transform it. Data becomes intelligence—revealing paths to growth, opportunities to innovate, and how best to serve customers. Getting this right requires a deep understanding of behaviors and trends: what they are, what they mean, how they will evolve. Yet, at most organizations, internal data tells just part of the story. And that data is rarely combined with AI decision-making that fosters rapid insights and responses. **Data Intelligence AI by BCG X** changes the equation.

We planted the seeds for Data Intelligence AI in our own work, rigorously testing its data and AI assets across industries. We’ve used these capabilities to help clients with scenario planning, inventory management, workforce optimization, and more. Now we offer them as a holistic yet modular ecosystem, enabling organizations to choose their own path in AI decision-making—and always uncover their next path to value. By augmenting your own data with third-party datasets, it adds context to internal data. And by infusing [artificial intelligence](https://www.bcg.com/capabilities/artificial-intelligence) in data analytics, it lets you uncover—and quickly act on—the opportunities that matter most.

Data Intelligence AI isn’t designed for any one use or user. It covers everything from forecasting and creating 360-degree customer profiles to optimizing B2B strategies and collaborating with partners. It also enables fast, secure access to data and simplifies data visualization. The result is the most important transformation of all: data becomes competitive advantage.

Data Intelligence AI by BCG X

Data Intelligence AI by BCG X leverages advanced analytics to help business leaders shed new light on customers, trends, and opportunities. Combining proprietary models, real-time leading indicators, and a rich array of external datasets, our data-to-solutions accelerator helps clients make their next, best decision.



Introducing Data Intelligence AI

A Holistic Approach to Data Intelligence

Data Intelligence AI is a data-to-solutions accelerator: an ecosystem of capabilities that help you make smarter decisions.

## The Benefits of Data Intelligence AI

Every organization has its own starting point. Some are well down the road in leveraging AI in data analytics; others are just now dipping their toes in the water. That’s why our data intelligence platform is designed for adaptability. Working together with our dedicated Data Intelligence AI team, we help you target the capabilities you need now—with the ability to add more capabilities later as your expertise and ambitions grow. But no matter what route you take, you’ll always benefit from the cornerstones of Data Intelligence AI: a rich array of external datasets provided by more than three dozen BCG partnerships plus proprietary models for AI decision-making.

1.

#### B2B Intelligence

Our AI-powered data accelerator helps [B2B clients](https://www.bcg.com/capabilities/pricing-revenue-management/b2b-pricing) identify leads, discover white spaces, and optimize business strategies—from what to sell to how to price and market it. Combining first- and third-party data, including financial metrics and IT spending, we provide a 360-degree view of customers, bringing data intelligence—and outcomes—to the next level.

2.

#### Customer 360 Profiles
